Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the director of "Say It with Flowers" (John Baxter) died later than the director of "Boot Hill Bandits" (S. Roy Luby). The error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the task as determining which director lived to an older age, rather than comparing the actual dates of death. Although John Baxter lived to an older age (79 years) than S. Roy Luby (72 years), Luby died later (in 1976) than Baxter (in 1975). This misinterpretation of the problem led to the incorrect final answer.
